description: This script is a Node.js-based utility for watching file paths for changes and restarting a separate Node.js process when changes are detected, likely used for development or automation workflows.

methods.name: buildRunnerArgs
methods.description: Constructs the arguments array for spawning the runner process, prepending the runner script path.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Converts file paths to a normalized, consistent format with forward slashes and removing leading './'.

methods.name: resolveRepoPath
methods.description: Resolves a file path relative to the repository root, normalizing the path.

methods.name: isIgnoredWatchPath
methods.description: Determines whether a given watch path should be ignored based on relevance to restart signals.

methods.name: runWatchMain
methods.description: Main async function to start the file watch process, spawn child processes, and handle restart logic upon file changes.
